status: FRESH CURRENT PRIMARY SOURCE AUTHOR ASSESSMENTS; independent review pending; no source/date approval

members.assessment: The central name is explicitly 張華, crown prince’s 少傅 after Hui’s accession (s0201–02), father of companion 禕 (s0205), and defender of the prince beside Pei Wei in the forged-letter deliberation (s0044–65). The draft’s actual authors Pan Yue and delivering maid Chengfu are distinct people; Zhang Hua is the opposing minister.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 遍示諸公王，莫有言者，惟張華、裴頠證明太子。
盛選德望以為師傅，以何劭為太師，王戎為太傅，楊濟為太保，裴楷為少師，張華為少傅，和嶠為少保。
於是使太保衛瓘息庭、司空泰息略、太子太傅楊濟息毖、太子少師裴楷息憲、太子少傅張華息禕、尚書令華暠息恆與太子游處，以相輔導焉。

members.assessment: The praising reply names 晉則裴楷、張華 in explicit contrast to Han exemplars. It retrospectively cites the learned Jin court figure, not the later addressee or author. Suishu077s0128 repeats this exact paired Jin comparison.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。

members.assessment: In Wu’s annals, Taikang3 s0499–500 appoints 尚書張華 to supervise Youzhou military affairs. This specific Jin career and northern command fit the same minister who later serves Hui, not an unrelated later Zhang Hua.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 甲午，以尚書張華都督幽州諸軍事。

members.assessment: Hui’s sixth-year court appointment expressly promotes 中書監張華 to 司空 beside Sima Tai and Sima Rong. It bridges the named Palace Secretariat official to the Minister of Works appearing in the same annals’ later death account.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 以中書監張華爲司空，太尉、隴西王泰爲尚書令，衛將軍、梁王肜爲太子太保。

members.assessment: Hui’s Yongkang coup account s0124 names 司空張華 and Pei Wei killed when Sima Lun forges the removal of Jia. It is the same paired defenders/ministers as Jin053 and Tongjian083, not the separate actors in the forged edict.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 永康元年春正月癸亥朔，大赦，改元。
癸巳，梁王肜、趙王倫矯詔廢賈后爲庶人，司空張華、尚書僕射裴頠皆遇害，侍中賈謐及黨與數十人皆伏誅。

members.assessment: The Yongkang astrological narrative explicitly says Sima Lun deposed Jia and 斬司空張華 after the prince’s killing. Specific office and fall connect the same Zhang Hua to Jin004 and Tongjian083.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 是月，賈后殺太子，趙王倫尋廢殺後，斬司空張華。

members.assessment: The later astrological account repeats 司空張華’s disaster with Jia/JiaMi’s fall and then his beheading by Lun. The preceding YuanKang comet and later coup are different temporal layers; both refer to the already identified minister.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 惠帝元康五年四月，有星孛於奎，至軒轅、太微，經三台、太陵。
後五年，司空張華遇禍，賈后廢死，魯公賈謐誅。
是月賈后殺太子，趙王倫尋廢殺后，斬司空張華，又廢帝自立。

members.assessment: 中書令張華 authors the A/B/C marriage-rite question before Zheng Chong, Jia Chong, Ren Kai and Xun Yi/Xun Xu’s opinions. This named Jin court official is the same Zhang Hua; the hypothetical spouses A/B/C are not his own household or new biographical family facts.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 中書令張華造甲乙之問曰：「甲娶乙為妻，後又娶丙，匿不說有乙，居家如二嫡，無有貴賤之差。

members.assessment: The music history places 張華等所制高文 under Wu’s Taishi9 court reform with Xun Xu. This establishes the Jin court lyricist, linked by name and collaborators to the later explicit Yellow Gate commission.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 泰始九年，光祿大夫荀勖始作古尺，以調聲韻，仍以張華等所制高文，陳諸下管。

members.assessment: 晉初 and 泰始五年 frame the explicit 黃門侍郎張華 commissioned with Fu Xuan and Xun Xu for New Year, longevity and meal songs. This is the named early-Jin court writer, not a hymn’s imagined sovereign or a performer in a later dynasty.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 及晉初，食舉亦用《鹿鳴》。
至泰始五年，尚書奏，使太僕傅玄、中書監荀勖、黃門侍郎張華各造正旦行禮及王公上壽酒、食舉樂歌詩。

members.assessment: 張華以為 introduces the inherited-meter argument in s0298–301, followed by 此則華、勖所明異旨. His name, interlocutor Xun Xu and the continuing Jin court hymn debate link this critic directly to p072/p031. The quoted passage is his opinion, not narrative about a second Hua.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 張華以為「魏上壽、食舉詩及漢氏所施用，其文句長短不齊，未皆合古。
蓋以依詠弦節，本有因循，而識樂知音，足以制聲度曲，法用率非凡近之所能改。
二代三京，襲而不變，雖詩章辭異，興廢隨時，至其韻逗留曲折，皆系於舊，有由然也。
是以一皆因就，不敢有所改易。」
此則華、勖所明異旨也。

members.assessment: Both explicit 張華 hymn headings sit in the same Jin music treatise author sequence. The broader Taishi commission and matching Nanqi/Sui accounts connect the writer; no activity year is invented for these undated headings.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 冬至初歲小會歌張華
宴會歌張華

members.assessment: 命將出征歌張華 and 勞還師歌張華 are author headings in the same Jin court-song group. The quoted Chonghua and earlier dynastic examples in the verses are lyric subjects, not separate name occurrences of the author or evidence of his actual command.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 命將出征歌張華
重華隆帝道，戎蠻或不賓。
徐夷興有周，鬼方亦違殷。
今在盛明世，寇虐動四垠。
豺狼染牙爪，群生號穹旻。
元帥統方夏，出車撫涼秦。
眾貞必以律，臧否實在人。
威信加殊類，疏逖思自親。
單醪豈有味，挾纊感至仁。
武功尚止戈，七德美安民。
遠跡由斯舉，永世無風塵。
勞還師歌張華

members.assessment: 中宮所歌張華 and 宗親會歌張華 identify the same attributed Jin hymn writer. Imperial consorts and exemplary women in the poem remain lyric subjects; the duplicated author records do not require new family relationships or dated activity.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 中宮所歌張華
先王統大業，玄化漸八維。
儀刑孚萬邦，內訓隆壼闈。
皇英垂帝典，《大雅》詠三妃。
執德宣隆教，正位理厥機。
含章體柔順，帥禮蹈謙祗。
《螽斯》弘慈惠，《樛木》逮幽微。
徽音穆清風，高義邈不追。
遺榮參日月，百世仰餘暉。
宗親會歌張華

members.assessment: s0562–66 explicitly ties Xun Xu’s Jin music reform and the Zhengde/Dayu lyrics to 張華之所作; s0567 repeats his name as Zhengde author. The hymn’s repeated Jin mandate supports the court context, not a new biographical event for every verse.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 使郭夏、宋識等造《正德》、《大豫》二舞，其樂章亦張華之所作雲。
正德舞歌張華
日皇上天，玄鑒惟光。
神器周回，五德代章。
祚命于晉，世有哲王。
弘濟區夏，陶甄萬方。
大明垂曜，旁燭無疆。
蚩蚩庶類，風德永康。

members.assessment: 大豫舞歌張華 is the second of the paired dance works just assigned to Zhang Hua in s0566. Exact author and work pair connects the heading to p109 and the same Jin writer; no new date is inferred from its praise language.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 大豫舞歌張華
惟天之命，符運有歸。
赫赫大晉，三後重暉。
繼明紹世，光撫九圍。
我皇紹期，遂在璿璣。
群生屬命，奄有庶邦。
慎徽五典，玄教遐通。
萬方同軌，率土咸雍。
爰制《大豫》，宣德舞功。
醇化既穆，王道協隆。
仁及草木，惠加昆蟲。
億兆夷人，悅仰皇風。
丕顯大業，永世彌崇。

members.assessment: The Yongkang/Lun succession-omen context names Zhang Hua killed and explicitly adds 壯武，華之封邑也. The fief-name bridge also explains later 張壯武 references; the omen is not a second person’s name.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 是月，壯武國有桑化為柏，而張華遇害。
壯武，華之封邑也。

members.assessment: The New Code memorial explicitly pairs 中書侍郎張華 with Lu Ting, asking that capital articles be posted at relay stations. The same named early Jin court official/writer appears; legal article subjects are not biographical crimes by him.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 是時侍中盧珽、中書侍郎張華又表：「抄《新律》諸死罪條目，懸之亭傳，以示兆庶。」
有詔從之。

members.assessment: After Yang Jun’s fall, 中書監張華 argues that the dowager should remain 武帝皇后 in a detached palace. This is Hui’s minister responding to Jia’s court pressure; historical Zhao empress is only his cited precedent.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 中書監張華等以為「太后非得罪于先帝者也，今黨惡所親，[3]為不母于聖世。
宜依孝成趙皇后故事，曰武帝皇后，處之離宮，以全貴終之恩。」

members.assessment: The Pei Wei biography pairs 司空張華 and Jia Mo in the plan concerning Jia, gives Hua’s reply, and later explicitly says Pei and Zhang opposed Minhuai’s deposition, directing readers to 華傳. The distinctive debate matches Tongjian083 and Jin053.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 頠深慮賈后亂政，與司空張華、侍中賈模議廢之而立謝淑妃。
華、模皆曰：「帝自無廢黜之意，若吾等專行之，上心不以為是。
且諸王方剛，朋黨異議，恐禍如發機，身死國危，無益社稷。」
華曰：「卿二人猶且見信，然勤為左右陳禍福之戒，冀無大悖。
幸天下尚安，庶可優遊卒歲。」
此謀遂寢。
湣懷太子之廢也，頠與張華苦爭不從，語在《華傳》。

members.assessment: The same Pei biography’s Lun grudge and Pei Kai’s post-SimaWei Secretariat service name 張華 as colleague of Pei/WangRong. The Shangshu/Secretariat allocation in s0270 reinforces the continuous Hui court identity; Sima Wei’s death belongs to Wei.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 初，趙王倫諂事賈后，頠甚惡之，倫數求官，頠與張華復固執不許，由是深為倫所怨。
瑋既伏誅，以楷為中書令，加侍中，與張華、王戎並管機要。
今張華在中書，王戎在尚書，足舉其契，無為復令楷入，名臣不多，當見將養，不違其志，要其遠濟之益。」

members.assessment: Wei Shu’s early-Taikang memorial joins 衛瓘、山濤、張華 for Feng/Shan after reunification. The named Western Jin court setting identifies this minister; the pre-existing canonical component’s Nanshi/Sui records remain included without pruning.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 舒與衛瓘、山濤、張華等以六合混一，宜用古典封禪東嶽，前後累陳其事，帝謙讓不許。

members.assessment: He Jiao’s post-Wu-conquest palace-attendant account explicitly says he befriended Ren Kai and Zhang Hua. Court, associates and period connect this friend to the same minister, distinct from He Jiao and the prince criticized thereafter.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 嶠轉侍中，愈被親禮，與任愷、張華相善。

members.assessment: The Jia Chong/Ren Kai faction account directly lists 張華 among Kai’s friends at s0401, beside Yu Chun/Xiang Xiu/He Jiao. The earlier s0387 is a date anchor for the continuing Taishi frame, not an independent Zhang Hua name occurrence.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 泰始初，鄭沖、王祥、何曾、荀顗、裴秀等各以老疾歸第。
充既為帝所遇，欲專名勢，而庾純、張華、溫顒、向秀、和嶠之徒皆與愷善，楊珧、王恂、華廙等充所親敬，於是朋黨紛然。

members.assessment: Wang Jun sends He Pan to present the Wu campaign plan; the emperor directs 張華與攀 to deliberate timing. This same Jin Wu counselor is explicitly recalled as 張華葉策晉武 in Xintangshu100.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 濬謀伐吳，遣攀奉表詣台，口陳事機，詔再引見，乃令張華與攀籌量進時討之宜。

members.assessment: The Hui/Lun-era Bian family narrative says 張華之誅，粹以華婿免官. The executed Zhang Hua and Bian Cui son-in-law relation fit the same minister; Cui’s later fate and Bian Kun’s biography are not transferred to him.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 張華之誅，粹以華婿免官。

members.assessment: 中書監張華 recognizes Zhang Gui’s learning and talent in the Wu-era court context. The two Zhang men are explicitly separate: Hua is the established patron, Gui the young candidate. No common-surname shortcut merges them.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 中書監張華與軌論經義及政事損益，甚器之，謂安定中正為蔽善抑才，乃美為之談，以為二品之精。

members.assessment: 司空張華為倫所誅 is explicit; Shao’s ensuing hostile assessment disputes restoration of Hua’s honors. The criticism is attributed to Shao and does not imply a different Hua or require treating blame as an objective identity fact.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 司空張華為倫所誅，議者追理其事，欲復其爵，紹又駁曰：「臣之事君，當除煩去惑。
華歷位內外，雖粗有善事，然闔棺之責，著於遠近，兆禍始亂，華實為之。

members.assessment: Liu Shen’s biography records his 申理張華 alongside talent advocacy, before Qi Wang’s government. This is a later defense of the already killed Jin minister, not a new living Zhang Hua at every subsequent event in Shen’s biography.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 敦儒道，愛賢能，進霍原為二品，及申理張華，皆辭旨明峻，為當時所稱。

members.assessment: Pei Wei recommends Wei Zhong to 司空張華; Zhong’s refusal calls the patron 茂先. Tongjian083s0119–20 repeats the same recommender, rejected summons, Maoxian criticism and Jia connection, directly identifying one man.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 頠為僕射，數言之于司空張華，華辟之，辭疾不起。
且茂先華而不實，裴頠欲而無厭，棄典禮而附賊後，若此，豈大丈夫之所宜行邪！

members.assessment: The Yuankang biographies name Zhang Hua judging Fan Qiao’s nomination and sending his son to encourage Lu Sheng. The Secretariat/talent-patron setting is the same Hui minister. The source’s 司徒 office wording is retained as printed; no career emendation is required for identity.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 時張華領司徒，天下所舉凡十七人，于喬特發優論。
中書令張華遣子勸其更仕，再徵博士，舉中書郎，皆不就。

members.assessment: 中書監張華 orders Chen Zhun to memorialize Huo Yuan’s top rank in the explicit Yuankang frame, while Liu Shen argues the grade. This links named Secretariat patron Hua to the same talented-men networks in Jin089.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 詔下司徒參論，中書監張華令陳准奏為上品，詔可。

members.assessment: The explicit 安北將軍張華 recognizes young Murong Gui and gives him cap-and-pin gifts. The earlier northern-command career in Jin003 and the same full name support one Jin official; Gui’s subsequent succession narrative is distinct.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 安北將軍張華雅有知人之鑒，廆童丱時往謁之，華甚歎異，謂曰：「君至長必為命世之器，匡難濟時者也。」
因以所服簪幘遺廆，結殷勤而別。

members.assessment: Han Yuan’s Tang memorial uses Zhang Hua as an old state-preserving example, paired with Weizi and dynastic decline. It is historical comparison, not Tang service; the fall-of-Jin minister from the other sources is intended.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 昔微子去之而殷國以亡，張華不死而綱紀不亂，國之慾謝，善人其衰。

members.assessment: The Zhang-empress family passage names her father Muzhi as 晉司空華六世孫 and says ancestor Yu was implicated in Hua’s execution. Nanshi012 repeats Muzhi’s exact courtesy name and sixth-generation Jin Sikong ancestry; the executed Jin Hua is the same Zhang Hua.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 父穆之，字思靜，晉司空華六世孫。
曾祖輿坐華誅，徙興古，未至召還。

members.assessment: Ai explicitly recalls 昔晉武庫火，張華 and his explanation about stored oil. Song032 independently names Zhang Hua at the Jin arsenal fire; this is an earlier Jin comparison in Ai’s Liang case, not a contemporary Liang minister.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 藹曰：「昔晉武庫火，張華以爲積油萬石必然。

members.assessment: Lu Chui compares Liu Xian’s learning to 吾家平原詣張壯武 and Wang Can visiting Cai Yong. The Zhang Zhuangwu reference is linked by Jin028’s explicit 張華/壯武封邑 bridge. It is a historical learned host, not the current Liu Xian or a new inferred date.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 陸倕聞之歎曰：「劉郎可謂差人，雖吾家平原詣張壯武，王粲謁伯喈，必無此對。」

members.assessment: A Qi ritual-text discussion cites Zhang Hua and Xiahou Zhan among earlier hymn-form precedents, distinguishing later Song authors. This is the Jin lyricist already explicitly commissioned in Jin022, not a new Qi official.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 張華、夏侯湛亦同前式。

members.assessment: The sequence starts 晉泰始五年 Fu Xuan and explicitly assigns the New Year/meal hymns to 黃門郎張華, then compares Xun Xu and Chenggong Sui. Exact office, collaborators and works repeat Jin022s0290.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 正旦大會行禮歌詩四章，壽酒詩一章，食舉東西廂樂十三章，黃門郎張華作。

members.assessment: The named Zhengde/Dayu lyrics by Fu Xuan and Zhang Hua follow the explicit 晉泰始九年 dance origin and precede Song changes. These are the same paired Jin works named in Jin022s0566.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 《正德大豫舞》，傅玄、張華各爲歌辭。

members.assessment: Qi Gao’s letter to Yu Wanzhi cites 張華爲度支尚書 as an older successful fiscal precedent. Nanshi047 repeats the same letter and words. The speaker and addressee remain Qi figures; Zhang Hua is the recalled Jin finance official.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 時太祖參政，與玩之書曰：「張華爲度支尚書，事不徒然。

members.assessment: Muzhi is explicitly 晉司空華六世孫, with his courtesy name and later descendants matching Liang007’s Zhang-empress lineage. The generation-distance relationship locates Hua as an ancestor, not a Song/Liang contemporary. The full existing3-member component is preserved.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 穆之字思靜，晉司空華六世孫也。

members.assessment: The Gao/Yu Wanzhi correspondence repeats 張華為度支尚書 verbatim from Nanqi034. Exact letter, office and recalled example connect the same historical finance minister; the long subsequent register reform belongs to Wanzhi.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 齊高帝參政，與玩之書曰：「張華為度支尚書，事不徒然。

members.assessment: The Wu/Hui omen narrative cites Zhang Hua’s disregarded merits, his response to the YuanKang arsenal fire and his warning with Yan Zuan about the heir’s deposition. These distinctive court events tie the same minister to Jin053/Tongjian083, not the current author Gan Bao.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 是時帝納馮紞之間，廢張華之功；
張華疑有亂，先固守，然後救災。
張華、閻纂皆曰，武庫火而氐、羌反，太子見廢，則四海可知矣。

members.assessment: The Hui/Jia/Minhuai context explicitly says Zhang Hua did not adopt Pei Wei and Liu Bian’s plan. This matches the debates in Jin035/Tongjian083 and remains the same cautious chief minister.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 帝既眊弱，而張華又不納裴頠、劉卞之謀，故后遂與謐誣殺太子也。

members.assessment: The Yongkang Zhuangwu mulberry-omen clause names Zhang Hua killed, repeating Jin028s0674–75’s fief/death conjunction. It identifies the same victim, not a person named by the omen plant.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 是月，張華遇害。

members.assessment: Niu Hong’s Sui music report explicitly frames Jin Wu/Taishi and quotes Zhang Hua’s Han/Wei meter argument, matching Jin022s0298–301. The Sui memorialist and Jin quoted authority are distinct people; no Sui life participation is inferred.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 張華表曰：「按漢、魏所用，雖詩章辭異，興廢隨時，至其韻逗曲折，並系於舊，一皆因襲，不敢有所改也。」

members.assessment: The actual named occurrence is s0128 晉則裴楷、張華, matching Beishi088’s paired historical comparison. s0112 names Sima Xiangru/Mei Sheng and supplies no Hua attribute. The later Sui reply date is not Hua’s life date; the old3-member canonical component is retained on its primary identity evidence.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 馬卿辭武騎之官，枚乘罷弘農之守。
漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華，雞樹騰聲，鵷池播美，望我清塵，悠然路絕。

members.assessment: The work list explicitly names 晉司空張華博物志 as the older work corrected by Chang Jing. This identifies the Jin minister/author, while Jing is editor and author of subsequent works; the actions must not be interchanged.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 景所著述數百篇，見行於世，刪正晉司空張華博物志及撰儒林、列女傳各數十篇云。

members.assessment: Tang Gaozu compares Feng Lun’s Qin-campaign advice with 張華葉策晉武. This exact Jin Wu counselor role matches the He Pan/Wang Jun Wu-conquest context in Jin045. The Tang campaign date belongs to the comparison event, not Zhang Hua’s personal life.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 賊平，帝謂侍臣曰：「始議東討，時多沮解者，唯秦王謂必克，倫贊其行，雖張華葉策晉武，亦何以加於是！」

members.assessment: The Pei Wei/Jia Mo debate, rejected Wei Zhong summons and Maoxian criticism repeat Jin035/Jin089. It is the same Zhang Hua who counsels restraint toward Jia, with full and shortened name references governed by the explicit name.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 裴頠與模及張華議廢后，更立謝淑妃。
模、華皆曰：「主上自無廢黜之意，而吾等專行之，倘上心不以為然，將若之何！
華曰：「卿二人於中宮皆親戚，言或見信，宜數為陳禍福之戒，庶無大悖，則天下尚未至於亂，吾曹得以估游卒歲而已。」
裴頠薦平陽韋忠於張華，華辟之，忠辭疾不起。
人問其故，忠曰：「張茂先華而不實，裴逸民欲而無厭，棄典禮而附賊後，此豈大丈夫之所為哉！

members.assessment: Liu Bian asks Zhang Hua about Jia’s scheme and hears his refusal; later Hua opposes the heir’s deposition at Shiqian. These connected episodes match Jin053s0059 and Jin035’s cross-reference to his biography.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 左衛率東平劉卞，以賈后之謀問張華，華曰：「不聞。」
華曰：「假令有此，君欲如何？」
華曰：「今天子當陽，太子，人子也，吾又不受阿衡之命，忽相與行此，是無君父而以不孝示天下也。
張華曰：「此國之大禍，自古以來，常因廢黜正嫡以致喪亂。
后見華等意堅，懼事變，乃表免太子為庶人，詔許之。

members.assessment: His son Wei urges retirement, Sima Ya solicits support, he refuses and is killed under Lun; he recalls the Shiqian remonstrance and Yan Zuan mourns his corpse. This distinctive narrative and family tie join the early-court Hua references to the same executed minister.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 張華少子韙勸華遜位，華不從，曰：「天道幽遠，不如靜以待之。」
以張華、裴頠安常保位，難與行權，右軍將軍趙王倫執兵柄，性貪冒，可假以濟事。
癸巳，秀使司馬雅告張華曰：「趙王欲與公共匡社稷，為天下除害，使雅以告。」
華拒之。
倫陰與秀謀篡位，欲先除朝望，且報宿怨，乃執張華、裴頠、解系、解結等於殿前。
華謂張林曰：「卿欲害忠臣邪？」
華曰：「式乾之議，臣諫事具存，可覆按也。」
華無以對。
遂皆斬之，仍夷三族。
閻纘撫張華屍慟哭曰：「早語君遜位而不肯，今果不免，命也！」

members.assessment: Zhang Lin alleges Liu Song belonged to Zhang Hua’s party after the Zhang/Pei killings. It refers to that already executed Hua, not another current office holder or Zhang Lin himself.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 張林積忿不已，以頌為張華之黨，將殺之。
